title: Present Perfect чи Past Simple
explanation:
Головне питання: **чи важливий точний час у минулому?**

- Є час або завершений період (*yesterday, last year, when I was a child, in May*) → **Past Simple**.
- Час не вказано, важливий досвід/результат, або період ще триває (*today, this month, ever, so far*) → **Present Perfect**.

Часто розмова **починається** з Present Perfect (загальний досвід), а **деталі** — у Past Simple:
*Have you ever been to Rome? — Yes, I **went** there two years ago. We **stayed** for a week.*

head: Present Perfect
Past Simple
rows: She's worked here for 3 years. (і далі працює)
She worked here for 3 years. (вже ні)
Did you see Anna this morning? (ранок минув)

examples.en: I've been to Lviv many times. Last time I went there in May.
examples.uk: Я багато разів бував у Львові. Востаннє їздив у травні.

examples.en: Have you heard the news? Tom got a new job!
examples.uk: Чув новину? Том отримав нову роботу!

examples.en: We lived in Kyiv before the war.
examples.uk: До війни ми жили в Києві.

examples.en: I haven't seen him this week.
examples.uk: Я не бачив його цього тижня.

examples.en: When did you start learning English?

tip: Питання з **When…?** — завжди Past Simple: *When did you arrive?* (не ~~When have you arrived?~~).

exercises.prompt: So far I ___ this film three times.
My grandfather ___ in a factory all his life. He retired in 2005.
exercises.explanation: Дідусь уже на пенсії — період завершено → Past Simple.

exercises.prompt: ___ you see the match last night?
___ you ___ (be) to Gdańsk? — Yes, I went last year. (2 слова)

exercises.explanation: since + досі → Present Perfect: I have lived here since 2020.

exercises.sentence: When have you come to Poland?
exercises.explanation: When…? → Past Simple: When did you come to Poland?

exercises.prompt: Я ніколи не був у Лондоні.
answer: I have never been to London.

exercises.prompt: She started working here in 2021. She still works here.
answer: She has been working here since 2021.

exercises.uk: Я загубив ключі, тож не можу потрапити додому.
answer: I've lost my keys, so I can't get home.
I have lost my keys, so I can't get home.
I've lost my keys so I can't get into my house.
I've lost my keys, so I can't get in.
I've lost my keys and I can't get home.
I've lost my keys, so I can't get into the house.
